description: This file defines custom formatters for specific PDSCH (Physical Downlink Shared Channel) data structures used in 5G NR (New Radio) physical layer processing, including codeword descriptions and PDU (Protocol Data Unit) formatting.

classes.name: formatter<ocudu::pdsch_processor::codeword_description>
classes.description: Custom formatter for codeword description, formats modulation and redundancy version.

classes.name: formatter<ocudu::pdsch_processor::pdu_t>
classes.description: Custom formatter for PDSCH PDU, formats various fields including RNTI, resource block info, codewords, and other PDU parameters.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses formatting options for the formatter.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats the data structure into a string representation.
